newsitem.title: FRANCE: French EdF electric utility to cut rates.
newsitem.headline: French EdF electric utility to cut rates.

text.p: State utility Electricite de France said on Friday that it expected to cut prices by about six percent on average in 1997 and that it was aiming to bring rates down about 15 percent by the year 2000.
The group said its 1997 budget agreed at a meeting on Friday also forecast turnover of more than 185 billion francs next year, five billion less than in 1996 due to the rate cuts.
Some of the loss from cut rates will be absorbed by reducing the company's charges by nearly four billion francs, it said in a statement.
EdF forecast a profit for 1997 of 2.7 billion francs versus 3.7 billion for 1996.
